description: Defines data structures and interfaces related to RRM (Radio Resource Management) policies, including policy members, ratio groups, RB limits, and reconfiguration requests, with formatting support for printing RRM policy members.

classes.name: rrm_policy_member
classes.description: Represents a member of an RRM policy, identified by PLMN ID and S-NSSAI.

classes.name: rrm_policy_ratio_group
classes.description: Defines a group of RRM policies with resource type and ratio allocations.

classes.name: rrm_policy_ratio_rb_limits
classes.description: Specifies limits on dedicated, prioritized, and shared PRBs for a slice.

classes.name: du_cell_slice_reconfig_request
classes.description: Request structure for reconfiguring slicing policies on a DU cell.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for rrm_policy_member, compares PLMN ID and S-NSSAI.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formatter for ocudu::rrm_policy_member, outputs formatted string with PLMN, SST, and SD.
